newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Champalimaud to revise dividend policy.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Champalimaud to revise dividend policy.

text.p: The Champalimaud group is reviewing its dividend policy so as not to jeopardise its ability to sustain growth or invest aggressively, Luis Champalimaud, chairman of the group's leading banks, said on Thursday.

"We want a dividend pollicy that does not compromise sustained growth and an aggressive policy of constant investment in technology, human resources and new businesses," he said in a presentation to analysts to which Reuters had access.
"Risk our future health...for a suicidal dividend policy...is not our approach," he said.
The group was changing its policy, but nevertheless, "no other bank gave a dividend of 145 escudos," he said, in a clear reference to Banco Totta which has traditionally paid out high dividends.
Banco Totta paid 145 escudos per share on its 1996 results.
